items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: I couldn't take the Trevelo's chorus that he would do on Closer Walk With E or anything like that.

ctx.x: You hardly even know what it was on the world. That's right. But he didn't tell you anything about, like, okay, play four four, play this or do that or...?

No, I knew what he wanted because I knew... I knew Moreiro's style, you know, and I couldn't take the Trevelo's chorus that he would do on Closer Walk With E or anything like that. And I would... a few times I would have a solo, I would, you know, just improvise. Yeah. But as far as the rhythm, and I... at that time I was trying to play just strictly rhythm manjo and I... I just kept it very simple and... I played loud and... and... and straight four four. Yeah. Just a little, little syncopation once in a while.…

Could you describe the setup at the... this was at the Beverly Capitol? Mm-hmm. The setup there, the atmosphere, clientele, prices, the way the band was received, general atmosphere of the... of the club and so on.
